paper.title_en: Polarization Formalism for Photon-Gravitational Wave Mixing Around Magnetars
paper.abstract_en: The Gertsenshtein effect can be used to probe the stochastic gravitational wave background at high frequencies, well above the range of standard cosmological sources. In this paper, we revisit the conversion between electromagnetic and gravitational waves in the magnetosphere of magnetars by solving the evolution equations of the associated Stokes parameters. In the process, we point out that the adiabatic approximation usually taken in the literature is not generally justified in the context of the Gertsenshtein effect. To derive analytical results, we focus our attention on two specific geometries where the adiabatic approximation is valid. From these, we derive a lower bound on the stochastic gravitational wave background from the conversion of magnetar electromagnetic emission into gravitational waves, and an upper bound by requiring that the conversion of background gravitational waves into electromagnetic radiation does not exceed the observed magnetar flux in the X-ray band. Our results demonstrate that gravitational waves generated through the Gertsenshtein conversion of magnetar electromagnetic emission produce a negligible stochastic background, as anticipated.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文聚焦于利用Gertsenshtein效应探测高频随机引力波背景，并指出文献中常用的绝热近似在Gertsenshtein效应语境下一般并不成立，方法上通过求解Stokes参数演化方程并选取两个绝热近似成立的特定几何进行解析推导，给出了随机引力波背景的下界与上界，属于与PTA相关课题中理论性较强的工作；其结论（磁星电磁辐射经Gertsenshtein转换产生的随机背景可忽略）具有明确限定，未过度外推。
decision.title_zh: 磁星周围光子-引力波混合的偏振形式
decision.abstract_zh: Gertsenshtein效应可用于探测高频随机引力波背景，其频段远高于标准宇宙学源的范畴。本文通过求解相关Stokes参数的演化方程，重新审视磁星磁层中电磁波与引力波之间的转换。在此过程中，我们指出：文献中通常采用的绝热近似在Gertsenshtein效应语境下一般并不成立。为得到解析结果，我们将注意力集中于两个绝热近似成立的特定几何构型。由此，我们推导出由磁星电磁辐射转换为引力波所产生的随机引力波背景的下界，并通过要求背景引力波转换为电磁辐射的转换率不超过X射线波段观测到的磁星通量，推导出其上界。我们的结果表明，通过Gertsenshtein效应由磁星电磁辐射产生的引力波所贡献的随机背景可以忽略不计，这与预期一致。
